name: Skeletonwitch
description: '''Skeletonwitch''' is an American [[thrash metal]] band from [[Athens, Ohio]], formed in 2003. The band currently consists of lead guitarist Nate Garnette, rhythm guitarist Scott Hedrick,  bassist Evan Linger, and vocalist Adam Clemans. The band fired original vocalist Chance Garnette in late 2014 or early 2015. In early 2018, drummer Dustin Boltjes left the band after seven years.
